outcome: The candidate is on master as one commit, gated by a full launcher run on the exact tree, pushed, and installed on Central and DL560.
acceptance: Commit e39701529b15074fafddd8b781456cb9147900dd (tree ea19a9f118fb932b9940d5cb6b0c578cb9cafdb6) is on origin/master, where master was moved to it by a fast-forward from 1a17cf8ae71393542908bca505a529c846e79743.
